subject: Global variables are also shown to other browsers!

messages.author: c40032db7aeae93b
messages.subject: Global variables are also shown to other browsers!
parts:
Hi all,

I am working on Shiny Dashboard to show stats about Massive Open Online Courses (Moocs). I am running into an issue regarding two browsers accessing the web server. If one chooses a graph, it would be also shown to the other browsers. This should not happen. I've attached the github repo to the project [1]. I suspect the issue is regarding assigning variables into .GlobalEnv such as assign("comments_data", commentsDataFiles, envir = .GlobalEnv)

How can I change this behaviour to be session-specific variables? while having these variables to be accessed through out the different R files.


[1] https://github.com/moocobservatory/mooc-dashboard


Best regards,
Saud

messages.subject: Re: Global variables are also shown to other browsers!
parts:
Global variables (variables defined outside the server function OR variables that you assign with <<-) are in fact global to everyone. That's not a bug, that's what global variables are meant to do. Have you read through the scoping rules in Shiny? https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/scoping.html

It's a useful read and might help you with your problem
